features.title: Standalone Local MCP Server
acceptance: Six tools: browse_documents, get_document, get_document_structure, get_page_content, index_document, remove_document
Tests for tool listing, calling, error handling

features.title: Incremental Index Updates for Large Documents
acceptance: Detect changed sections between document versions
Rebuild only affected branches of the document tree
Recompute summaries only along impacted paths
Maintain document version history and change tracking

features.title: Pydantic Validation for LLM JSON Outputs
acceptance: Validate LLM responses against explicit Pydantic schemas
Detect malformed or incomplete responses early

features.title: Per-Call Chat Usage and Measurement Completeness
acceptance: Supported measurement surface shared by chat_completions, responses and messages
Preserve individual model-call records with call identity
Distinguish complete, partial and unknown measurements
